The truck is ready, the orders need to go out on time and meanwhile new goods are arriving in the warehouse. As a Logistics Employee, you make sure everything ends up in the right place. You pick orders, scan products and get pallets ready for shipping. Do you like to get stuck in and enjoy working in an environment where there is always something going on? Then read on! Employment type  Full-time  What will you do? As a Logistics Employee, you won't have to worry about sitting still. You pick daily orders, scan products and help load and unload incoming and outgoing trucks. In the refrigerated storage area, you stack and move goods and make sure pallets and products are scanned to the correct location. Before an order can leave, you make sure the pallets are securely wrapped, correctly labelled and can be transported safely. You also help check incoming stock and place materials and products on the correct racks and shelves. You also keep a close eye on the stock. Using a scanner or computer, you carry out stock checks, count products and check locations in the warehouse. That way, the team knows what is in stock and orders can be prepared for shipment or collection according to schedule.  The offer Of course, there is something in return: - A salary of €14,99 gross per hour; - A full-time job of 40 hours per week; - Working hours from 09:00 to 18:00; - A working week from Monday to Friday; - A varied role in logistics. jobs.occupation: Maintenance Technician – Relocate from Portugal to the Netherlands
jobs.description: Start your technical career in the Netherlands Are you an experienced Maintenance Technician based in Portugal and ready for an international step in your career? Xelvin is looking for motivated technical professionals who want to relocate to the Netherlands and work in industrial maintenance, production technology or technical service environments. In this role, you will work as part of a technical department and help keep machines, production lines and installations running smoothly. You will solve technical issues, carry out preventive maintenance and contribute to a safe, reliable and efficient production process. This position is suitable for technicians with experience in industrial maintenance, mechanics, electromechanics, automation or technical service. What you will do As a Maintenance Technician, you are responsible for maintaining, repairing and improving technical installations and production equipment. You will work in a practical, hands-on environment where no two days are the same. Your responsibilities may include: Performing preventive and corrective maintenance on machines, production lines and technical installations. Diagnosing mechanical, electrical, pneumatic or hydraulic faults. Repairing and replacing machine parts, sensors, motors, pumps, conveyors or other technical components. Supporting production teams when technical problems occur. Carrying out inspections and basic testing of equipment. Reading and using technical drawings, electrical diagrams or machine documentation. Registering maintenance activities and technical findings. Thinking along about improvements in reliability, safety and efficiency. Working according to safety standards and company procedures. Cooperating with colleagues from production, engineering and technical service. Depending on your experience, the role can be more mechanically, electrically or electromechanically focused. What Xelvin offers you Relocating to another country is a big step. Xelvin supports youthroughout the process, from the first interview to your first working day in the Netherlands. We offer: A full-time job with long-term perspective in the Netherlands. A competitive gross monthly salary between €2,800 and €4,200, depending on your experience, technical background and the type of company. Possible shift allowance, depending on the working schedule and production environment. 25 paid holidays, in addition to Dutch public holidays. 8.33% holiday allowance. Pension arrangement. Support with your relocation from Portugal to the Netherlands. Assistance with documentation needed to work in the Netherlands. Guidance from our housing consultant in finding accommodation. Support during onboarding and your first period in the Netherlands. Personal guidance from Xelvin. Opportunities for training, courses and career development. What you bring For the Portuguese market, we are looking for practical technicians with a solid technical education and hands-on experience in an industrial environment. You have: A technical education such as Curso Técnico Profissional / Nível 4 or higher in one of the following areas: Mecatrónica Manutenção Industrial Eletromecânica Eletrotecnia Automação Mecânica Industrial Technology or similar At least 2 years of experience in industrial maintenance, technical service, production maintenance or machine maintenance. Good mechanical and/or electrical troubleshooting skills. Experience with industrial equipment, production lines, machinery or automated systems. Basic knowledge of electrical, mechanical, pneumatic or hydraulic systems. The ability to read technical drawings or electrical schematics is a strong advantage. Experience with PLC-controlled machinery is a plus, but not always required. A practical, hands-on mindset. A safe and responsible way of working.
